From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@bluewave.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: runbook, QBR cadence & capacity asks (BlueWave)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our roadmap we’re starting the renewal discussion early to give you flexibility on term and capacity options. I put together a short kickoff runbook that outlines proposed milestones, a suggested QBR cadence, and the data we typically need from procurement to finalize pricing. Draft runbook attached.

High-level proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (today): kickoff and intro to CSM/SE
- Week 1: capacity profile & usage snapshots from BlueWave
- Week 2: pricing scenarios and term options (12/24/36 mo)
- Week 3: contract redlines and legal touchpoints
- Week 4: signature / go-live for committed capacity

Can you confirm who from procurement should be included? Also, are there specific calendar windows for a QBR in the week of July 12? I’ll coordinate a 30–45m slot and share a calendar invite.

Next steps I’ll take: share runbook (attached), loop in Monica (CSM) and Karthik (SE) for capacity and onboarding details, and prepare a pricing estimate once we have your typical 90-day token/embedding volumes.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri****@redwood.com
Attachments: bluewave_renewal_runbook_v1.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks, Priyom —

Appreciate the proactive timeline. I’ve looped in procurement (procure@bluewave.com) — that’s our internal inbox, and John Patel (legal procurement) will pick up the RFQ. For capacity: our product team expects a ~2.5x increase in peak generation over the next 12 months due to a new feature launch; I don’t have exact token numbers yet but can get a 90-day sample by Friday.

For QBR windows, the week of July 12 is tight for us. Can we do one of the following: July 14 10:00–10:45 ET or July 15 15:00–15:45 ET?

Also, procurement asks for an initial pricing worksheet and a draft SOW for committed capacity — can you send those before the QBR?

Elena Costa
Director of AI Platforms | BlueWave
elena.costa@bluewave.com

Quick note from the SE side —

I reviewed the initial capacity sketch. A 2.5x peak increase is feasible on our Dedicated offering with a staged uplift plan:
- Phase A (initial 30 days): modest headroom increase via burst capacity and caching tuning
- Phase B (30–90 days): reserved GPU uplift (quantized model variant) for steady-state peak
- Phase C (90+ days): discuss an architectural pass for more aggressive throughput (split-model routing)

I’ve attached a short onboarding checklist and a couple of configuration knobs we’ll want to set ahead of the QBR. I’ll be available for a technical pre-call if BlueWave wants to walk through spikes and response latency expectations.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: se_onboarding_checklist.md (attachment stub)
